fullDescription: Editorial magazine-style hero for an AI design agent: warm paper-cream canvas, Fraunces serif display headline with one italic burgundy accent word, minimal underlined text CTA, asymmetric 7/5 grid with a tinted framed photo, gold hairline rule, and a sticky translucent nav.

structured.summary: An editorial, magazine-style hero section for an AI product design agent. Warm paper-cream canvas, a Fraunces serif display headline broken across two lines with one italic burgundy accent word, a short standfirst paragraph, a minimal underlined text-link CTA (no button), and an asymmetric 7/5 grid pairing the type with a tinted, framed photographic plate. A thin gold rule separates the hero from an editorial metadata strip (pull-quote + two stat columns). Sticky translucent cream nav with backdrop blur, uppercase wide-tracked links, and an outlined pill 'Start free' CTA.

style.description: Print-editorial / fashion-journal aesthetic translated to web: warm off-white paper, deep near-black ink, a single muted burgundy accent and a soft gold rule. Type does the heavy lifting via Fraunces serif with tight negative tracking and an italic accent word; everything else is restrained, lots of air, hairline borders, and one tinted hero photo as the only color block.
style.prompt: Editorial print-magazine style on a warm paper-cream background (#faf6ef) with a faint two-spot radial paper-warmth wash (a burgundy 5% spot top-right, a gold 7% spot bottom-left). Text in near-black ink (#1c1815) used at 65-75% opacity for body and metadata. A single muted burgundy accent (#7b2d3b) for the italic display word, the kicker, eyebrow labels, and hover states; a soft antique gold (#b08a4f) reserved only for a thin horizontal divider rule that fades left-to-right from solid gold to 25% gold. Headline uses Fraunces (variable serif, optical sizing ~144) with line-height 0.96 and letter-spacing -0.018em, mixing weight 400 and a lighter 300 across lines plus a 400-italic burgundy accent word. Body and nav/labels use Inter; labels are 10.5-12.5px uppercase with very wide tracking (0.14em-0.28em). Hairline 10% ink borders, generous whitespace, no buttons in the hero body (a minimal underlined serif text link instead). The one image is a warm architectural/interior photo with a dark-to-burgundy bottom gradient tint and a heavy soft drop shadow (0 34px 64px -30px rgba(28,24,21,0.5)), nearly square corners (2px radius).

layout_and_structure.description: Full-width sticky header over a centered max-w-[1240px] hero column. The hero is a one-row asymmetric 12-col grid: left 7 columns hold kicker + headline + standfirst + text CTA, right 5 columns hold the framed image with an absolute caption. The grid items align to the bottom (items-end). Below the grid: a thin full-width gold rule, then a metadata strip that splits into a left italic pull-quote and a right cluster of two stat columns. On mobile it collapses to a single column and stacks.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header, z-50, translucent cream background (bg-cream/85) with backdrop-blur-md and a 1px bottom border at 10% ink. Inner row max-w-[1240px], px-6 to px-10, fixed height 68px, items vertically centered, space-between. Left: a serif wordmark 'Atelier' (Fraunces 500, 22px, tight tracking) followed by a small burgundy italic middot and a 15px burgundy italic 'studio' nudged up 1px. Center (hidden below md): nav links Library / Canvas / Journal / Pricing in Inter 500, 12.5px, uppercase, 0.16em tracking, ink at 65%, hover to burgundy. Right: an outlined pill link 'Start free' (1px ink-80 border, rounded-full, px-4 py-[7px], 12px uppercase 600, 0.14em tracking) that inverts to ink fill + cream text on hover.
Above the headline: a short 26px-wide 1px burgundy horizontal dash, gap-3, then a label 'The Prompt Library, Vol. 04' in Inter 600, 11.5px, uppercase, 0.28em tracking, burgundy.

prompts.partPt: Headline + standfirst + Chamada Final para Ação (left, 7 cols)
prompts.prompt: Fraunces serif display headline, weight 400, fluid size clamp(54px, 9.2vw, 128px), line-height 0.96, letter-spacing -0.018em. Two blocks: line 1 'The Brief'; line 2 in lighter weight 300 'Designs ' followed by an italic weight-400 burgundy 'Itself'. Below (mt-8 to mt-10), a standfirst paragraph max-w-[480px], Inter 16.5-17.5px, line-height 1.62, ink at 75%, describing prompt-to-screen on an infinite canvas. Below that (mt-10 to mt-12) a minimal CTA 'line': Fraunces 19px 500 ink, the words underlined via a bottom border at 40% ink that shifts to burgundy on hover, followed by a forward-arrow icon (material-symbols:arrow-forward-rounded, 22px) that slides 6px right on hover.

A figure with overflow-hidden and 2px radius carrying a heavy soft shadow. A full-width object-cover photo, height 300px / 400px / 480px across breakpoints, of a warm minimal architectural or interior scene. An absolute inset gradient tint overlay (transparent down to 18% ink then 42% burgundy at the bottom). An absolute bottom-left figcaption in cream at 90%, 10.5px uppercase 0.22em tracking 500: 'Plate 04 — Generated, then refined'.

After the grid (mt-16 to mt-20) a 1px full-width rule with a left-to-right gold gradient (solid #b08a4f fading to 25%). Then (mt-7) a metadata strip: flex column on mobile, row with space-between on sm+. Left: an italic Fraunces pull-quote, max-w-[360px], 16px, line-height 1.5, ink at 70%, e.g. the curly-quoted line about the fastest way from a sentence to a screen worth shipping. Right: two stat columns (gap-12 to gap-16) each with a tiny burgundy uppercase 0.2em label over a Fraunces 20px 500 number with a smaller 15px 400 ink-65 unit: 'In the library 2,400 prompts' and 'First draft ~30 seconds'.

special_ui_components.prompt: Sticky translucent cream nav with backdrop blur and an inverting outlined pill CTA
Fluid clamp() serif display headline mixing 300/400 weights with a single italic burgundy accent word
Minimal underlined serif text-link CTA with a hover-sliding arrow icon (no button)
Tinted, heavily-shadowed framed photo plate with an absolute uppercase figcaption
Left-to-right fading gold gradient hairline divider
Editorial metadata strip: italic serif pull-quote + two label/number stat columns

structured.special_notes: The look depends on restraint: keep the palette to exactly cream/ink/burgundy/gold, use burgundy only as a single accent (italic word, kicker, labels, hovers), and let Fraunces carry the personality with tight tracking and a near-1.0 line-height. No drop-shadows or fills anywhere except the one hero photo and the inverting nav pill. Use the icon set (Iconify material-symbols) for the arrow. The grid is intentionally asymmetric (7/5) and bottom-aligned; collapse to a single stacked column under lg.
